question:
In a certain code language,

A ? B means ‘A is the daughter of B’,

A = B means ‘A is the son of B’,

A @ B means ‘A is the father of B’,

and A √ B means ‘A is the sister of B’.

How is C related to L if 'C ? D @ E √ F = L'?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4bd0c654621a358af6b040e2cf85d8ee5c37c0f51056665b487f4863802f0dfe.png]

Given: C ? D @ E √ F = L

It means: C is the daughter of D, D is the father of E, E is the sister of F, F is the son of L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a5c1cdec01e7e55d87c2b97d1edbefdfe9fe23db926a54138ad03c5f2cb28582.png] 

Thus, C is daughter of L.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
